title: Buff Creeper
description: If creepers in Minecraft seem too easy for you, try this data pack
body: If creepers in Minecraft seem too easy for you, try this data pack. It's now crucial to finish off creepers promptly, otherwise they might explode with greater force. This data pack increases explosion strength, speed, and burn rate, reduces fall damage and fall distance, adds oxygen underwater, and modifies knockback on impact. It also adds a mechanic: at low health, a creeper moves faster, burns less, and can explode on its own. At low health, it explodes even faster and with greater force.
